newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Cinba cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Cinba cut to hold.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said Tuesday it downgraded Argentine winery CINBA to hold from buy.

-- "Since we initiated coverage of the stock five months ago, Cinba's stock price has skyrocketed by 70 percent and has outperformed the market by 37 percent," analyst Jose Costa Buck and Gonzalo Pangaro wrote in a report.

-- "Due to the stock price's outstanding performance and the fact that lower than expected earnings could put some downward pressure on the stock price in the short term, we are downgrading our recommendation."
